payload.rationale: Brief journey_stage is 'comparing': the couple is weighing Seminyak beachfront resorts, villas and beach clubs, so the primary invitation sits after the list of details venues do not publish, where answers in writing matter most. The secondary follows venues and travel, the magazine serves earlier-stage readers, and the closing CTA ends the post. Subtexts use only brand-facts reassurances: inclusions in writing, single point of contact, AUD quotes, time zone and fee agreed in writing. No prices, perks, Privileges or availability wording. A printable Seminyak venue comparison checklist would be a better-matched magnet; none is known to exist, so it is a backlog suggestion only and not placed.
